subject: Next steps: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & TrustVault portal access for Healthyly
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@healthyly.com>, procurement@healthyly.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + asks: SOC 2, data handling & next steps

Hi Marta / Healthyly team,

Thanks again for taking time today — really helpful call. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can keep momentum toward the pilot: 

- Recap from our call:
  * Primary use case: patient-facing summarization (no PHI in initial pilot), retention 30 days for cache only, production rollouts may include PHI later.
  * Expected QPS: low to start (30–50 requests/min), spikes during business hours.
  * Hosting preference: US-only region for data residency / HIPAA comfort.

- Asks / next steps from Healthyly so security can progress: 
  1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or an executed bridge letter if SOC2 in progress).
  2) Completed Vendor Security Questionnaire (attached is our VSQ template to speed this up).
  3) Any specific encryption/KMS requirements or a short note on your DLP rules we should be aware of.

If you can share the SOC 2 artifact or confirm that a bridge letter will be accepted, we can open a TrustVault upload link for your team to drop documents securely. Priyom will coordinate contract/PO touches once security clears.

I attached our VSQ template to make the questionnaire stage easier. Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your security team if helpful.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mailto:dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

Attachment: vsq_template.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@healthyly.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick recap + asks: SOC 2, data handling & next steps

Marta —

Appreciate the call yesterday. A couple of details from the security side to help prioritize documentation: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: If you already have the latest Type II report (covering system/process controls through 2026), please upload it. If the Type II is still pending, a signed bridge letter stating the scope and expected report delivery date is acceptable to unblock procurement for a pilot.

2) Bridge letter contents we typically need:
   - Scope (systems and services covered)
   - Effective period and assurance date
   - Signature block from an authorized security/compliance officer

3) TrustVault portal: we can provision a one-time secure upload link for Healthyly to drop sensitive artifacts. Please indicate who should receive the portal invite (email address + name) and whether you need credential expiry shorter than our default 7 days.

4) Encryption & KMS: if your org requires customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS), flag that now — the pilot can proceed without CMK, but enterprise deployment will need integration details.

Once we have the SOC2/bridge letter and the VSQ responses, I’ll run a quick internal review and get back with any targeted follow-up questions.

Ben Carter
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick status from Healthyly: 

- SOC 2: we have a Type II for the 2025 audit cycle; procurement needs to confirm whether that will satisfy the legal team. If not, we can provide a bridge letter signed by our Head of Security that covers the current control set while the 2026 Type II is finalizing.
- VSQ: procurement/security will work on completing the VSQ — we expect a first pass back by EOW (Friday).
- Portal access: please send the upload link/invite. Can we have the invite go to me (marta.novak@healthyly.com) and one backup (procurement@healthyly.com)? A 3-day expiry is preferred.

Attaching a short cover note that explains our internal timing. We'll also flag any PHI-related constraints if/when the pilot scope expands.

Marta Novak
